site: Zach Hyman was back in the lineup after missing six games.
rewrite: Zach Hyman was back in the lineup after missing six games, and the Oilers wasted no time.

site: Connor McDavid opened the scoring for the Oilers just 40 seconds into the game, and Hyman made it 2-0 on the power play midway through the first.
Mathieu Joseph scored his first goal for Edmonton 32 seconds later to make it 3-0.
rewrite: Connor McDavid opened the scoring just 40 seconds in, Hyman made it 2-0 on the power play midway through the first, and Mathieu Joseph scored his first goal for Edmonton 32 seconds after that to make it 3-0.

site: Trent Frederic and Jack McBain dropped the gloves late in the first.
rewrite: Trent Frederic and Jack McBain dropped the gloves late in the first.

site: Kasperi Kapanen and Leon Draisaitl scored just under three minutes apart midway through the second to stretch the lead to 5-0.
Utah pulled Karel Vejmelka after five goals and turned to Sebastian Cossa for the rest of the second.
rewrite: Kasperi Kapanen and Leon Draisaitl added goals just under three minutes apart midway through the second, and after the fifth, Utah pulled Karel Vejmelka for Sebastian Cossa.

site: John Marino and Mikhail Sergachev scored a minute and a half apart early in the third to cut Edmonton’s lead to 5-2.
McDavid scored again a little over four minutes later to make it 6-2 for the Oil.
rewrite: John Marino and Mikhail Sergachev scored a minute and a half apart early in the third to cut the lead to 5-2, but McDavid answered a little over four minutes later to make it 6-2 for the Oil.

site: McDavid added three assists for a five-point night.
rewrite: He added three assists for a five-point night.

site: The chances were closer than the score.
Tristan Jarry made 26 saves for the Oilers.
rewrite: The chances were closer than the score, and Tristan Jarry made 26 saves for the Oilers.

site: The Oilers moved to 6-1-1, second in the Pacific.
The Mammoth dropped to 6-3-0, still first in the Central.
rewrite: Edmonton moved to 6-1-1, second in the Pacific, and the Mammoth dropped to 6-3-0 but stayed first in the Central.
